models.vram_basis: My arithmetic, not measured: 8.03B params x ~4.85 bits/weight (typical Q4_K_M) / 8 = 4.9 GB, + ~2 GB allowance for modest context/compute buffers.
models.notes: Translation-specific model (task tag: translation), Dec 2025 update. The only dedicated translator I could verify. Dense/MoE layer split across GPUs is supported by llama.cpp; Pascal (P40) lacks fast fp16 so prefer llama.cpp over vLLM there (general knowledge, not from the page).

models.name: Qwen3.8-27B
models.vram_basis: My arithmetic, not measured: 27.8B params x ~4.85 bits/weight (typical Q4_K_M) / 8 = 16.9 GB, + ~4 GB allowance for modest context/compute buffers.
models.notes: General multilingual LLM; translation quality not verified here. Dense/MoE layer split across GPUs is supported by llama.cpp; Pascal (P40) lacks fast fp16 so prefer llama.cpp over vLLM there (general knowledge, not from the page).

models.name: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe 30B-A4B (speech translation)
models.vram_basis: My arithmetic, not measured: 33.7B params x 2 bytes (bf16/fp16) = 67.4 GB + ~4 GB allowance for VAE/text-encoder/activations. Quantised variants (fp8/GGUF) would be roughly half.
models.notes: Page tags include speech-translation; for audio-in translation only.
